title: EmailDraft
description: A draft outreach email plus its QA verdict. V2 NEVER sends this — it is stored at data/leads/<slug>/email.json for human review only, and export_gmail_drafts.py only ever produces a DRAFT_ONLY export.

preview_only.description: true if generated via generate_email.py --preview, bypassing the contact/freshness gates -- can never reach EMAIL_DRAFT_READY

recipient_email.description: populated only from a contact.json with contact_verified: true

facts_supported.description: every claim maps to a dossier.evidence_items entry

ranking_claims_sourced_and_dated.description: true if no exact ranking figure is cited, OR any cited figure has a dated evidence_items source

generic_reuse_percent.description: alias of checks.generic_reuse_risk_pct, kept at top level per Phase 13 spec

revision_of.description: prospect_id + version this rewrite supersedes, if any
